pair.title: Nibe S configuration
pair.not_connected: Not connected to the heat pump

detect.title: Detecting features
detect.intro: Connecting to the heat pump and watching which values change. This takes about half a minute.
detect.failed: Could not read from the heat pump

features.title: Select features
features.intro: Choose which features to monitor. Recommendations are based on what the heat pump reported.
features.insights_note: Disabling a feature removes its capabilities, including their Insights history.

discover.searching: Searching your network for Nibe heat pumps…
discover.none_found: No heat pump found automatically. Check that Modbus TCP is enabled on the pump (menu 7.5.9) or enter its IP address below.
discover.title: Find your heat pump
discover.confirm: Found your heat pump — tap to confirm

devices.title: Add devices
devices.intro: Each function of your pump becomes its own device. The ones we found live data for are checked, but you can add any of them.
devices.select_one: Select at least one device to add.
devices.main_desc: Overview: outdoor temperature, operating priority and mode, plus diagnostics and statistics
devices.analytics_desc: Helps the app author see which pump models and features are actually used, and where setup fails. No personal data, no readings from your home, no network details. You can change this later under app settings.

sources.prompt: More than one sensor can report this. Pick the one that should regulate:

tank.title: Hot water tank
tank.hint: Needed for the hot water estimate. One entry per family — the lining doesn't matter.
tank.inlet_hint: 10 °C is the usual figure; a little lower in winter, higher in summer.

setup.title: Device Setup
setup.intro: Set up the functions you selected.
setup.heating_intro: Choose the temperature that guides your heating.
setup.nibe: Use the heat pump’s native temperature sensor
setup.homey: Use your own Homey temperature sensors
setup.promise: Let your rooms guide the heating
setup.promise_desc: Use the temperature sensors you already have in Homey. Choose one room, or average several for a temperature that represents your home. Your pump keeps its thermostat and Smart Price Adaption.
setup.picker_intro: Find sensors by name, room, device type or app. Choose one or combine several.
setup.review_intro: Each selected sensor has equal influence.
setup.pending_hint: Add your devices first, then open Heating → Repair to finish the pump setup. Leave your current NIBE sensor in control until then. No temperatures are sent during pairing.
setup.pump_intro: Check these settings on your heat pump, then verify here.
setup.pump_enable: Enable external room sensor BT50 in menu 7.5.9.2.
setup.pump_zone: Assign BT50 to your heating zone in room sensor / zone settings (1.3.3 / 1.3.4).
setup.pump_control: Select BT50 to control heating. Remove the previous controlling sensor if you want to replace it.
setup.zone_confirm: I have selected BT50 to control the intended zone.
setup.feed_warning: Verify settings starts regular temperature updates. They continue when you close Repair. If Homey or a selected sensor stops supplying valid readings, BT50 can alarm; restore your NIBE sensor and disable external BT50 on the pump. Complete this step while you can access the pump.
setup.verified: The pump received the temperature at BT50.
setup.active_note: Temperature updates continue in the background. To stop them, use Heating Setup to return to your NIBE sensor first.
setup.handover_hint: On the pump, select your original sensor to control the zone and disable external BT50. The current feed continues until you verify here.
setup.handover_confirm: My NIBE sensor is controlling the zone again.
setup.no_nibe_sources: No live NIBE source choices were detected. The current/default source will be kept.
setup.analytics_benefit: Nibe Live is built by one developer with one heat pump. Sharing how the app works with yours helps uncover compatibility issues, improve setup and focus development on the features you use.
setup.analytics_details: Includes your pump model, app features used and technical events such as setup failures and connection problems. Temperature readings, device names and Flow names are never included.
setup.analytics_optional: Optional. Turn it off anytime in device settings → Privacy.
setup.request_timeout: Homey did not respond. Please try again.
setup.source_intro: Choose which sensor supplies the indoor temperature used to control your heating.
setup.source_homey_desc: Use one sensor or average several rooms. Your heat pump stays in control.
setup.feed_short: Verification starts regular temperature updates, which continue after you close Repair.
setup.feed_recovery: If Homey or a sensor stops reporting, BT50 may alarm. Restore the NIBE sensor and disable external BT50 on your pump.
setup.zone_detail: Menus 1.3.3 / 1.3.4 · Assign BT50 to the zone you want to heat.
setup.control_detail: Replace the previous controlling sensor if needed.
setup.success_description: Your heat pump is now receiving temperatures from your Homey sensors.

gateway.title: Gateway connection
gateway.hint: Choose how NIBE register 40025 is addressed on your connection. Confirm with a working Modbus query. The same convention applies to all reads and writes.
gateway.invalid: Choose a gateway, a port from 1–65535 and a Modbus ID from 1–247.
gateway.detect_intro: Checking the values your heat pump reports. Depending on the gateway, this can take several minutes.

hotwater.cal_waiting: Charge cycles recorded so far: __CYCLES__. Two that heat the tank differently are needed before a size can be worked out.
